1.text:
<C:0001,0001,><C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0004,>～Volume 5～
[The Great Battle]<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0000,>The Pi'illos were fundamentally a
peaceful people, and they held to this
tenet as best they could.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>However, with their land and culture
held hostage, their fury grew terrible
and they fought without mercy.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>At Prince Dreambert's command,
the Pi'illos hurled themselves into the
fray in an all-out attack on Antasma.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>None would permit Antasma's dark
designs to come to fruition, even if it
meant their own lives were forfeit.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>For all knew that the Dark Stone,
that nightmare in crystalline form,
must never be used.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>Yet even when the battle went ill,
no spirit quailed, for the Pi'illos knew
they had a powerful ally.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>The power of this ally was without
equal. And it stood with the Pi'illos.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>It was the Zeekeeper.
The bird of legend.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0001,>Continued in Volume 6...
[The Feathered Guardian]<C:0003,0001,>

3.text:
<C:0001,0001,><C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0004,>～Volume 6～
[The Feathered Guardian]<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0000,>Legend has it that the Zeekeeper was
a bird of enormous girth who watched
over and guarded people's dreams.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>It was massive, draped in iridescent
feathers, and terrifying when roused
in defence of the righteous.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>The great bird lived in quiet peace as
it watched over the island dwellers,
but in battle, it was dire.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>From its mind's eye, the Zeekeeper
could launch a Wakebeam, a weapon
of unimaginable power versus evil.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>This weapon bedevilled Antasma in
battle to the point of despair.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>And so, with the help of their mighty
ally, it looked as though the Pi'illos 
would prove the victors at long last.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>As he looked upon the field of battle,
Prince Dreambert awaited his chance
to execute one final manoeuvre.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>Little did he know, however, that his
plan would lead to utter ruin.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0001,>Continued in Volume 7...
[The Wise One's Gambit]<C:0003,0001,>

5.text:
<C:0001,0001,><C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0004,>～Volume 7～
[The Wise One's Gambit]<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0000,><C:0001,0004,>As he listened to reports of the battle,
Dreambert mulled over courses of action.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0000,>"How can we do the most good?
We must defeat Antasma, but how can
we ensure this danger never returns?"<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>To answer his question, the prince
called forth one of his subjects.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>It was none other than Eldream.
Long-lived and wise, he knew all there
was about the island and dreams.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>Eldream was also the only Pi'illo who
had befriended the animals of the
island, with whom he shared kinship.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>Prince Dreambert, in close counsel
with this wise and ancient advisor,
concocted a secret plan.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>The plan was this: to seal Antasma
deep within a dream...forever.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>But could the evil one be eternally
imprisoned in the dark, ethereal pit
known only as Dream's Deep?<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0001,>Continued in Volume 8...
[The Nightmare's Dream]<C:0003,0001,>

7.text:
<C:0001,0001,><C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0004,>～Author's Postscript～<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0000,>Buh huh huh huh huh! Oh hello, loyal reader!
It is I, Pi'illoper, your humble author and bed
lover, wrecking the fourth wall to add a word!<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>As my imaginary friends know, I have always
had a great passion for the noble Pi'illos, and
it led me to self-publish these little screeds!<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>Some might call it fan fiction... I snort at that!
How much fan fiction has TEN volumes? Huh?
Not many, I'd bet. Did you read them all?<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>Buh huh huh! Not to toot my own horn here,
but who'd imagine I could write a masterpiece
with such a dearth of historical materials?<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>Which reminds me, my imaginary lawyers advise
me to assert that this work is not affiliated
with Pi'illo Castle or any official Pi'illo anything!<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>All this humble author hopes is that you might
read these and gain a greater appreciation for
the Pi'illo folk, be the tales real or imagined!<C:0003,0001,>

lover, wrecking the fourth wall to add a word!<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>As my imaginary friends know, I have always
had a great passion for the noble Pi'illos, and
it led me to self-publish these little screeds!<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>Some might call it fan fiction... I snort at that!
How much fan fiction has TEN volumes? Huh?
Not many, I'd bet. Did you read them all?<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>Buh huh huh! Not to toot my own horn here,
but who'd imagine I could write a masterpiece
with such a dearth of historical materials?<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>Which reminds me, my imaginary lawyers advise
me to assert that this work is not affiliated
with Pi'illo Castle or any official Pi'illo anything!<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>All this humble author hopes is that you might
read these and gain a greater appreciation for
the Pi'illo folk, be the tales real or imagined!<C:0003,0001,>
